Order Order

In this petition, the petitioner is seeking quashing of the entire criminal prosecution initiated against him by the opposite party No.2 in ICC Case No.2059 of 2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 420/294/323/506 of the IPC pending in the Court of the learned S.D.J.M.,
Bhubaneswar.
2.
Vide order dated 08.10.2024 of this Court the matter was referred to the Orissa High Court Mediation Centre for mediation.
3. The petitioner and the opposite party No.2 had participated in the mediation process and the mediation came out to be successful.
Vide letter dated 27.11.2024, the High Court of Orissa Mediation Centre has placed on record the mediation report.

Settled Agreement between both the parties

Pursuant to the order of the Hon'ble High Court vide its order dtd. 08.10.2024 in CRLMC No.3709 of 2023 directed parties concerned to place their record to Coordinator at Mediation Centre, Aain Seva Bhawan, Cuttack to resolve their dispute.

sentences.text:
During the time of mediation as per my persuasion both the parties are agreed on 20.11.2024 to resolve their dispute between themselves on the following terms and conditions and stated herein after:-
(1) That, it is agreed between the parties concerned the petitioner namely Gandharbasen Behera shall pay a sum of Rs.2,50,000/- (Two Lakh Fifty Thousand Only) to the informant i.e. Pramod Kumar Das in shape of Demand Draft.

(2) That as per agreed between parties concerned the petitioner will pay Rs.2,50,000/- (Two Lakh Fifty Thousand Only) in shape of aforesaid demand draft only to opposite party (informant) namely Pramod Kumar Das within three months from today i.e. on 20.11.2024 before the Hon'ble High Court, Cuttack.

(3) That, it is agreed between the parties concerned both parties shall appear before the Hon'ble Oath Commission at Hon'ble High Court, Orissa, Cuttack, where the petitioner shall file an affidavit towards their claim within the seven days from today i.e. on 20.11.2024 before quashing of application under Section 482 Cr. P.C. by the Hon'ble High Court.

(4) That, it is agreed between parties concerned, the informant will no further claim in any where/any court of law towards his alleged claim in connection with Kharavela Nagar C.T. Case No.921/2023 corresponding to P.S. Case No.262/2023, ICC Case No.2059/2023 U/s. 294, 323, 420, 506 IPC & I.C.C. Case No.3791/2022 pending before the learned SDJM, Bhubaneswar in respect of vide two cheques bearing No.417606 and 127401, under section 138 of NI Act r/w 420 of I.P.C.
(5) That, it is agreed between parties concerned, that the petitioner and opposite party (informant) being satisfied with their aforesaid mutual understanding they will withdraw their respective cases filed by them which are pending in any court of law.
There shall be no further claim by the opposite party (informant) and the petitioner against each other in future in any manner.
In view of the terms and conditions both the parties are agreed with their proposals between them.

Hence, the mediation became successful."
4.
Learned counsels appearing for both the parties conjointly submit that the present petition may be disposed of in terms of the aforementioned mediation settlement.
5. Regard being had to the submissions made by the learned counsels for the parties at the Bar, the CRLMC is disposed of.
The mediation report as produced in the preceding paragraphs shall form part of the present order.
